article.title: Huge scandal exposes how USA uses criminals to manipulate elections in Latin America
article.author: Editor
article.content: Huge scandal in Latin America: far-right election meddling specialist Fernando Cerimedo was arrested for trying to assassinate his ex-girlfriend. He oversaw disinformation campaigns for region’s conservative pro-U.S. presidents and has links to Trump admin.
